label: TP
reason: User-supplied input flows directly to response output without proper sanitization. The 'mitigation' of removing only the last character (via substring) is ineffective against XSS - payloads like '<script>' remain executable even after truncation. Additionally, X-XSS-Protection header is explicitly disabled ('0'), confirming intentional bypass of browser protections.

evidence.note: Inadequate sanitization - only removes last character, leaving dangerous chars like < intact
Unsanitized variable passed to response writer
